messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 P1 alert: sudden p99 latency spike and elevated 5xx rate on inference-gateway (hosted). P95 up ~2x, P99 up ~8-12x. Error rate 5xx x3 baseline. Deployed ~10m ago: commit abc1234 (service: inference-gateway). Canary passed but global rollout started. Dashboards: https://grafana.company/s/dashboards/inference-gateway
alice (oncall): I'm on it. Paging eng-sre and runtime. Observing region-eu and region-na more impacted. Traffic graph shows tail spikes aligning with a pattern of long-lived requests piling up.
bob (eng-sre): Looking at envoy & gateway logs: many entries like `upstream response timeout after 30s` and `connection reset by peer` for backend pool. Connection pool metrics show saturation — active connections jumped after the deploy. No obvious OOMs on pods.

carol (runtime): The rollout enabled a new connpool behavior: `--enable-stream-multiplex=true` in the gateway config (PR 452). That changes HTTP/2 stream multiplexing and keeps connections alive longer. If backend has a soft concurrency limit, it can cause head-of-line stalls. I suspect request head blocking -> p99 tail.

dave (frontend): We have customer reports with 502s and timeouts from EU. Quick check: curl to gateway returns 502 intermittently. Example: `curl -v https://gw.eu.example/api/v1/Invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` shows `upstream prematurely closed connection` repeatedly.

erin (support): Escalating — affected customers: AcmeCorp (significant), several PLG devs hitting errors. Tracking in #customer-alerts. Alerted CSMs and CS.

alice (oncall): We need fast mitigation. Options: revert deploy (rollback), hotpatch gateway to revert mux flag, or route traffic to previous model variant/older fleet. I prefer rollback to last known good if it completes quickly. Agree? :eyes:

frank (product): Need to minimize customer impact. If rollback reduces availability window, do it. Notify customers with interim message.

bob (eng-sre): I can hotpatch configmap to disable multiplexing immediately while rollback proceeds. Patch command below — will apply to all clusters where configmap mounted:

```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap inference-gateway-config -p '{"data": {"enable_stream_multiplex": "false", "upstream_timeout": "60s"}}'
```

(Deploy-bot: please note configmap patch may trigger rolling restart of gateway pods depending on config handling.)
deploy-bot: Rollback requested by @alice. Initiating `kubectl rollout undo` for deployment/inference-gateway to revision 178. Starting in cluster-prod-eu. Tracking progress...

carol (runtime): Hotpatching first so we don't risk partial rollback fallout. Rolling configmap patch now in eu. Patching... done. Monitoring.

bob (eng-sre): After patch, connection pool metrics show drop in active connections and fewer 502s in EU, p95 trending down. But p99 still elevated in NA. Rollback proceeding in parallel.

alice (oncall): Rollback status? deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: Rollback progress: eu: 1/1 deployments rolled back (success), na: 0/2 in progress, apac: queued. ETA for global rollback ~6 minutes.

frank (product): Support will send a brief customer message: "We've detected elevated errors affecting some requests; engineers are actively mitigating (rollback in progress). We'll update in 15m." Erin can you send? :pray:
erin (support): Drafted and sent to impacted customers and status page updated.

bob (eng-sre): NA cluster rollback finished. We see p95 back to baseline, p99 dropping from 900ms spikes to ~120ms. 5xx rate returning to normal. Metrics: error-rate down 70% vs peak.

carol (runtime): Confirmed the multiplex flag was root cause — queues were forming due to backend concurrency limits exposed by multiplexing change. We'll gate this flag behind performance tests going forward.

alice (oncall): Good job. Leaving a short mitigation checklist: rollback completed, hotpatch applied, customer comms sent, monitoring watch for 30m. Can someone create a postmortem ticket? Assign to runtime + eng-sre.

frank (product): I'll file postmortem with high-level timeline and customer impact. Add action: require load-test + soak for connection-pool changes.

bob (eng-sre): One follow-up: we should add circuit-breaker/backpressure for long-tail requests and tune envoy's max streams/idle time to avoid similar cascade.
deploy-bot: All rollbacks completed. No further rollout in progress.

alice (oncall): Last check: p99 ~ baseline, error budget dip accounted. I will close the P1 after 30m watch if stable. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

frank (product): Postmortem ticket created: PM-7864. Assigning to carol/bob. Please include the PR (#452) context and the hotpatch diff.

incident-bot: Incident closed to P2 watchlist at 1745679005. Metrics will be archived for postmortem.
